_readme: The ONE place for time budgets (seconds). target = what it SHOULD take; alarm = hard ceiling. ALL targets are PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0 (carried over from the donor project, not re-measured here). A breach or a rising trend is an investigation entry in .claude/docs/build-times.md, never a reason to raise a number here silently.

changes.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: one checkout + one git diff

server-tests.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: the test task alone, single fork on 4 vCPU; leaves headroom of the server job for setup, compile, detekt and Kover

server.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: compile + detekt + tests + Kover on 4 vCPU; a small foundation suite with a tiny DB should not need more

gradle-vulnerability-scan.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: resolve lockfiles + one trivy run on a few thousand lines of lockfile

web.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: npm ci (cached) + lint + knip + vitest + vite build of a small SPA

e2e-static.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: npm ci (cached) + eslint + knip + tsc over a handful of specs

images.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: multi-stage docker build (gradle installDist + vite build) as a plain compose build, plus the Trivy image scan; the floor is Gradle in Docker plus the Trivy databases

k8s-static.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: one checkout + a kubeconform download + validation of the small manifest set, twice (raw and rendered)

e2e.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: nightly: images build + compose up + Playwright over a tiny stack

ci-steps._readme: Per-step budgets, keyed '<job>/<step name>' exactly as the workflow names the step; ci-times.mjs --steps <job> shows them beside each step's time. Same rules as above: a breach is a WHY entry, never a silent raise.

e2e/Install e2e deps.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: npm ci of the e2e workspace with the npm cache

e2e/Install Playwright browser.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: install-deps (apt) with the browser cached; slower on a cold cache when chromium is downloaded

e2e/Build images.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: a plain docker compose build of the app image, no layer cache: the same build as the ci.yml images job

e2e/Start the stack.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: postgres + app (JVM boot + Flyway) healthy under `up --wait`; the app's healthcheck start_period is 30 s

e2e/Run E2E.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: the Playwright specs alone against a running stack

server-build.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: ./gradlew cleanTest check :server:installDist -Pforks=1 (scripts/gates.sh default): compile, detekt, all tests, Kover, alignment

server-test.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: ./gradlew :server:test against one shared Postgres container

web-gates.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: lint:api + check:api + lint + knip + test:coverage + build

e2e-static.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: lint + knip + typecheck + check:scenarios

e2e-playwright.why: PROVISIONAL until measured at v0.1.0: blackbox suite against a running compose stack
